title: Cambridge/Coventry stickers
description: White stickers with black letters are common in those two cities

title: Norther England walls
description: Their structure is very distinctive: a well-organized lower section topped by a layer in which the semi-precious stones are set at an angle

title: Aberdeen granite houses (Scotland)
description: Scotland can be flat and agricultural too, but almost only in the east, around Aberdeen. Houses there are very characteristic and common: slate roof, exposed grey stone walls (or render of the same colour) and a chimney at each end of the house.
